title: Meselson and Stahl: DNA copies itself semi-conservatively
caption: Bacteria grown in heavy nitrogen (¹⁵N) were moved to light nitrogen (¹⁴N). After one generation all the DNA was a single hybrid band; after two, half hybrid and half light. Semi-conservative copying predicts exactly that; conservative copying would have left a heavy band at generation 1.
alt: Tubes of DNA bands for generations 0, 1 and 2: semi-conservative copying gives heavy, then all hybrid, then half hybrid and half light, matching the observations; conservative copying predicts a heavy band and a light band at generation 1, which was not seen.
description: Generation 1, observed: one band of intermediate density, so every molecule has one old and one new strand.
Generation 2, observed: half the DNA hybrid, half light.
Semi-conservative copying predicts exactly these bands.
Conservative copying predicts a heavy band and a light band at generation 1, so it is ruled out.

groups.label: conservative: predicts a heavy band at generation 1, which was not seen
